Event Start
	Form.Caption = Format("GXSPC_SelectionList", "Live Move Attribute Rules2")
	&ADVANCED_LABEL_TEMPLATE = "%1 <strong>%2</strong>"
EndEvent

Event 'Toggle'
	if AdvancedContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainer
		AdvancedContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainer + !" " + StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerVisible
		BtnToggle.Class += !" " + StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aBtnToggleActive
	else
		AdvancedContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainer
		BtnToggle.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aBtnToggle
	endif
Endevent

Event LblLiveMoveAttributeRules2IdFilter.Click
	if LiveMoveAttributeRules2IdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		LiveMoveAttributeRules2IdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem + !" " + StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItemExpanded
		&cLiveMoveAttributeRules2Id.Visible = true
	else
		LiveMoveAttributeRules2IdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		&cLiveMoveAttributeRules2Id.Visible = false
	endif
EndEvent

Event LblLiveMoveAttributeRules2DescriptionFilter.Click
	if LiveMoveAttributeRules2DescriptionFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		LiveMoveAttributeRules2DescriptionFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem + !" " + StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItemExpanded
		&cLiveMoveAttributeRules2Description.Visible = true
	else
		LiveMoveAttributeRules2DescriptionFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		&cLiveMoveAttributeRules2Description.Visible = false
	endif
EndEvent

Event LblLiveMoveAttributeRules2CodeFilter.Click
	if LiveMoveAttributeRules2CodeFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		LiveMoveAttributeRules2CodeFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem + !" " + StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItemExpanded
		&cLiveMoveAttributeRules2Code.Visible = true
	else
		LiveMoveAttributeRules2CodeFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		&cLiveMoveAttributeRules2Code.Visible = false
	endif
EndEvent

Event Load
	&LinkSelection.FromImage(selectRow)
EndEvent

Event Enter
	&pLiveMoveAttributeRules2Id = LiveMoveAttributeRules2Id
	Return
EndEvent
